desc: Compact, easy to maneuver, and hyper accurate, the X-Bolt 2 All Purpose is a ranch-style rifle with the performance-driven features made famous by the X-Bolt, all rolled into a revised action with additional bolt guidance for smoother bolt operation. Featuring a 16-1/2" heavy sporter contour barrel with 5/8"-24 suppressor-ready threading, the rifle is optimized for a suppressor, dense woods hunting, or keeping handy when checking fence lines. The action is bedded, and the barrel is free floated for consistent accuracy.
